description: A seemingly inaccurate author-attested `idempotent` claim on a binding is not a core document defect; truth of the claim is outside document conformance.
notes: All tests are positive (valid: true). Operation names tempt plausibility heuristics, but such heuristics cannot establish a document-rule violation. Tools remain free to use the claim in their own decisions.

tests.description: write-shaped binding claims idempotent: true — plausibility cannot determine document validity
read-shaped binding claims idempotent: false — apparent inaccuracy in the other direction
mass-delete operation’s binding claims idempotent: true — bait for a method-name heuristic, though §5.3 itself notes repeated deletion can be idempotent; either way the attestation stands
